Name: IshaliArt's Portrait Mod -Work in Progress-
Author: IshaliArt
Description:
Work in progress of my portrait mod!


Mod Requirements
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]
[/list]
Install Instructions
[list]
[*]To install this mod move the 'IshaliArt' folder to Mods > Portraiture > Portraits folder
[*]Press 'P' in game while talking to someone to activate the mod.
[*]If you'd like to use the alternate versions of characters, change the file name to the character name. ( HarveyNoGlasses.png > Harvey )
[/list]
PLEASE if you truly appreciate the mod and want to support me DO NOT redistribute, DO NOT modify the mod contents.
